commit.message:
fix(security): disable unauthenticated /api/register account takeover

This legacy endpoint had no auth dependency, let the caller pick rol_id
1/2 (CEO/Administrador), and assigned tenant_id from the oldest real
organization in the system - full unauthenticated takeover of a real
tenant. routers/auth_router.py already disables /auth/register with
this same message; this duplicate had never been deactivated.
